config.z_definition: dNet / rolling_std(dNet, 52w, min 26w), no mean subtraction
config.price_source: cot-analyzer/data_cache/<SYM>.parquet 'Closing Price' on the Tuesday report date, nearest within 3 days
config.hac: Newey-West Bartlett kernel, lag h-1, within market, summed across markets
config.small_oi_flag: 100 contracts > 0.5 sigma of dNet at the latest date
config.state_names_note: gold names kept verbatim; MM_* reads as TREND_* on tff

friday_anchored.anchor_rule: first daily close >= report_date + 3 days, end = first daily close >= anchor + 13 weeks
